title: Lock file uses the first format, which records less restore detail
description: packages.lock.json declares a `packages.lock.json` on the older lock-file format. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `packages.lock.json` on the older lock-file format.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a `packages.lock.json` on the older lock-file format.
limitation: It matches a `packages.lock.json` on the older lock-file format in the parsed packages.lock.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
